rule: Two rules for the same target. (1) Named slot: a stat modifier is keyed by a name; the caller refuses a same-slot application that is not stronger, a stronger one removes the old modifier and adds the new one with its full duration, and modifiers in different slots add. (2) Poison tier ladder: an active poison blocks any equal or lower tier, a higher tier replaces it (timer restarted); a creature's immune tier at or above the poison tier refuses it, and a paragon raises its immune tier by one. A poison tick is one plus a percent of current HP, clamped to the tier band; the tick count is fixed. Locks (paralyze, freeze) are one flag and one timer: a re-application during the lock is ignored, not extended; a paralyzing blow refuses a paralysed target and opens an immunity window after each lock. Bleed restarts its timer on a new bleed, runs five ticks two seconds apart, with a level that falls each tick and damage in a band over that level. Death clears poison and both locks.

data_fields.name: slot.key
data_fields.unit: string, one slot per key per target

data_fields.name: poison.pctCurrentHpPerTick
data_fields.unit: percent of current HP before clamp

data_fields.name: bleed.levelStart
data_fields.unit: integer, falls by one per tick

data_fields.name: knockBack.divisor

keep: Named-slot rule: stronger replaces and restarts, weaker refused, different slots sum.
Poison tier ladder: equal or lower tier refused while active; higher replaces.
Creature immune tier with a one-tier boss bump (the boss-elite pattern).
Bleed beat: five ticks, falling size, one sound and one blood decal per tick, a final message.
Death clears poison and both locks.
change: All ticks and rolls are server-side; the client only plays what the server decided.
Drop the pre-AOS coin-flip repeat and the 40 percent reveal as they stand.
breaksOnDamage is per effect in data (donor paralysis breaks on damage; donor freeze does not in the path read).
Numbers, names, sounds and icons are ours.

Defect in the donor's Bombard knock-back: chance divided by 20 with a comment that says 12 percent, so every cast from a skill sum of 20 knocks back. Fix: clamp(sum / divisor, 0, maxChance) with divisor and maxChance as data fields.
look_test: On the duel stub, three attackers each start a Bleed within one second, then a buff and a curse land on the same stat. Dom watches on a 375 wide phone. Pass when there is one Bleed with one timer and a falling tick size, a stronger poison replaces a weaker one and an equal one does nothing, the buff and the curse both show, and the post-lock window stops a second lock. Compare against a per-attacker Bleed stack.
